claims.claim_ar: يَجُوزُ أَنْ يكون «مِنْهُمْ» رافِعًا لِمَنْ، وَأَنْ يَكُونَ مُبْتَدَأً وَخَبَرًا، وَالْجُمْلَةُ نَعْتٌ لِرُسُلٍ، وَأَنْ يَكُونَ مُسْتَأْنَفًا.
claims.claim_en: The phrase 'minhum' may be analyzed in different ways: (a) it may be 'raised' (i.e. rendered nominative) as a subject referring to 'man', (b) it may form a nominal sentence (mubtada and khabar), (c) the clause may function as an adjective (na't) modifying 'rusul', or (d) it may be an independent (resumed) clause (musta'naf).
